recipes.name: Papanași
recipes.description: Fried cottage-cheese doughnuts topped with sour cream and sour cherry jam, crisp outside and fluffy inside.
instructions: Mix cottage cheese, eggs, sugar, lemon zest, baking soda and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Work in the semolina and flour to form a soft, slightly sticky dough; rest 15 minutes.
With floured hands shape rings about 8 cm wide and small balls from the leftover dough.
Fry in hot oil over medium heat, 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden.
Drain on paper, then top each ring with a ball, a spoon of sour cream and plenty of jam.

recipes.name: Cozonac cu Nucă
recipes.description: Rich Romanian holiday sweet bread swirled with a walnut, cocoa and rum filling.
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in warm milk with a spoon of sugar and let it foam for 10 minutes.
Beat the egg yolks with the remaining sugar, salt, lemon zest and rum extract, then combine with the flour and yeast mixture.
Knead for 15 minutes, gradually working in the soft butter, until smooth and elastic; cover and let rise until doubled, about 1.5 hours.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold in ground walnuts, cocoa, 50 g sugar and raisins for the filling.
Divide the dough in two, roll each into a rectangle, spread with filling and roll up tightly, then twist the two rolls together.
Place in a lined loaf tin, let rise 45 minutes, brush with beaten egg and bake at 170 C for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Mere
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo pie filled with grated cinnamon apples, dusted with powdered sugar.
instructions: Coarsely grate the apples, squeeze out excess juice and cook with sugar and cinnamon for 10 minutes until soft; stir in the breadcrumbs.
Butter a baking tray and layer half the phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread the apple filling evenly and cover with the remaining sheets, buttering each one.
Score the top into squares and bake at 180 C for 35 to 40 minutes until golden.
Cool slightly and dust generously with powdered sugar before cutting.

recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Brânză Dulce
recipes.description: Crisp phyllo layers around a sweet vanilla cottage-cheese filling studded with raisins.
instructions: Mix cottage cheese with eggs, sugar, vanilla sugar, semolina, raisins and lemon zest until creamy.
Line a buttered tray with half the phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread the cheese filling and cover with the remaining buttered sheets, tucking in the edges.
Whisk sour cream with one egg and pour over the top so it soaks into the layers.
Bake at 180 C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Clătite cu Dulceață
recipes.description: Thin Romanian crepes rolled around fruit jam and dusted with powdered sugar.
instructions: Whisk eggs with sugar and salt, then add milk, sparkling water, vanilla and flour to make a thin, lump-free batter; rest 20 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan and pour in a small ladle of batter, swirling to coat thinly.
Cook 1 minute until the edges lift, flip and cook 30 seconds more; repeat with the rest.
Spread each crepe with jam, roll or fold into quarters.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve warm.

recipes.name: Gogoși Pufoase
recipes.description: Pillowy fried yeast doughnuts rolled in powdered sugar, best eaten warm.
instructions: Dissolve yeast and a teaspoon of sugar in warm milk and leave 10 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, salt, egg yolks, vanilla and the yeast milk; knead 10 minutes, adding the soft butter at the end.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll out to 1.5 cm thick, cut rounds with a glass and let them rest 20 minutes.
Fry in oil at 170 C for 2 minutes per side until golden, drain on paper and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Salam de Biscuiți
recipes.description: No-bake chocolate biscuit log with walnuts, raisins and Turkish delight, sliced like a salami.
instructions: Break the biscuits into small irregular pieces and dice the Turkish delight.
Melt butter with milk, sugar and cocoa in a saucepan, stirring until smooth; cool slightly and add rum extract.
Pour over the biscuits, walnuts, raisins and Turkish delight and mix until everything is coated.
Shape into a thick log on cling film, roll tightly and twist the ends.
Chill at least 4 hours, then dust with powdered sugar and cut into slices.

recipes.name: Negresă
recipes.description: Dense, moist Romanian cocoa cake with walnuts, cut into squares and dusted with sugar.
instructions: Whisk eggs with sugar until pale, then stir in oil, milk and vanilla.
Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt and fold into the wet mixture.
Fold in the chopped walnuts and pour into a lined 25 cm square tin.
Bake at 180 C for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out with moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin, dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Chec Marmorat cu Cacao
recipes.description: Classic Romanian marble loaf with swirls of vanilla and cocoa sponge, soft and buttery.
instructions: Separate the eggs and whisk the whites with a pinch of salt to stiff peaks.
Beat yolks with sugar until creamy, add oil, milk and vanilla, then fold in flour and baking powder.
Gently fold in the egg whites, then transfer one third of the batter to a bowl and mix in the cocoa.
Alternate spoonfuls of light and dark batter in a lined loaf tin and swirl once with a knife.
Bake at 170 C for 45 to 50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Cremșnit
recipes.description: Two crisp puff pastry sheets sandwiching a thick vanilla custard and whipped cream.
instructions: Bake the puff pastry sheets between two trays at 200 C for 20 minutes until golden; cool.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar, cornstarch and 100 ml of the milk until smooth.
Heat the remaining milk with vanilla, pour over the yolk mixture, return to the pan and cook, stirring, until very thick.
Stir in the butter, cover with cling film and cool completely, then fold in the whipped heavy cream.
Spread the cream over one pastry sheet, top with the second, chill 4 hours and dust with powdered sugar before cutting.

recipes.name: Savarină
recipes.description: Light yeast cakes soaked in rum syrup, split and filled with whipped cream and jam.
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk with a teaspoon of sugar; mix with flour, eggs, 30 g sugar, salt and soft butter into a sticky batter.
Spoon into buttered muffin or savarin moulds, let rise 40 minutes and bake at 180 C for 20 minutes.
Boil water with the remaining sugar for 5 minutes, remove from heat and add rum extract and lemon juice.
Dip the warm cakes in the hot syrup until fully soaked, then drain on a rack.
Whip the cream with powdered sugar, split each cake open, fill with cream and finish with a spoon of jam.

recipes.name: Orez cu Lapte
recipes.description: Creamy Romanian rice pudding simmered slowly in vanilla milk and finished with cinnamon.
instructions: Rinse the rice and simmer it in the water for 10 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Add the milk, sugar, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt and cook over low heat, stirring often, for 30 to 35 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter and let rest 5 minutes.
Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with cinnamon; serve warm or chilled with a little jam.

recipes.name: Griș cu Lapte
recipes.description: Silky semolina pudding cooked in sweet vanilla milk and topped with a swirl of jam.
instructions: Bring the milk to a simmer with sugar, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt.
Pour in the semolina in a thin stream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Cook over low heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy; stir in the butter.
Divide into bowls and top each with a spoon of jam or a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Budincă de Tăiței
recipes.description: Baked sweet noodle pudding with cottage cheese, raisins and lemon zest, golden on top.
instructions: Cook the noodles in lightly salted water until just tender, drain and toss with half the butter.
Beat eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar, then mix in cottage cheese, sour cream, raisins and lemon zest.
Fold the noodles into the cheese mixture and pour into a buttered baking dish.
Dot the top with the remaining butter and bake at 180 C for 35 to 40 minutes until set and golden.
Cool 10 minutes, dust with powdered sugar and serve warm.

recipes.name: Lapte de Pasăre
recipes.description: Romanian floating islands: soft meringue clouds poached in milk over a silky vanilla custard.
instructions: Separate the eggs and whisk the whites with 50 g sugar and a pinch of salt to firm, glossy peaks.
Bring the milk to a gentle simmer with the vanilla and drop in spoonfuls of meringue; poach 1 minute per side, then lift onto a plate.
Whisk the yolks with the remaining sugar, slowly pour in the hot milk and return to the pan.
Cook over low heat, stirring, until the custard coats the back of a spoon; do not let it boil.
Pour the custard into a serving dish, float the meringues on top and chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Cornulețe cu Gem
recipes.description: Tender crescent cookies made with sour cream dough, filled with jam and rolled in powdered sugar.
instructions: Rub the cold butter into the flour until crumbly, then mix in sour cream, egg yolks, yeast, vanilla sugar and salt to form a soft dough.
Wrap and chill for at least 1 hour.
Divide into 4 pieces, roll each into a thin circle and cut into 12 triangles.
Put half a teaspoon of thick jam at the wide end of each triangle and roll up towards the tip.
Bake at 180 C for 15 to 18 minutes until lightly golden, then roll in powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.name: Prăjitura Albinița
recipes.description: Thin honey sheets layered with a smooth semolina and butter cream, softened overnight.
instructions: Melt honey with butter and sugar, cool slightly, then mix in the egg, baking soda and enough flour to form a firm dough.
Divide into 3 pieces and roll each very thinly to fit a lined tray; bake each sheet at 180 C for 7 to 8 minutes.
Cook the semolina in the milk with the remaining sugar and lemon zest until thick, then cool completely.
Beat the soft butter until fluffy and gradually beat in the cooled semolina to make a smooth cream.
Spread half the cream on one sheet, add the second sheet and a thin layer of jam, then the rest of the cream and the top sheet.
Press lightly, refrigerate overnight and dust with powdered sugar before cutting into squares.

recipes.name: Baklava cu Nuci
recipes.description: Layers of buttery phyllo and spiced walnuts soaked in a lemon-honey syrup.
instructions: Pulse the walnuts with cinnamon and 50 g sugar until coarsely ground.
Butter a tray and layer 8 phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter; sprinkle with a third of the nuts.
Repeat twice more and finish with the remaining sheets, buttering each; cut into diamonds with a sharp knife.
Bake at 170 C for 45 to 50 minutes until crisp and golden.
Meanwhile boil water, remaining sugar, honey and lemon juice for 10 minutes; pour the hot syrup over the hot baklava.
Let it soak at room temperature for at least 6 hours before serving.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.description: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with airy mascarpone cream and finished with cocoa.
instructions: Brew strong coffee, stir in the rum and let it cool.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar over a pan of simmering water for 5 minutes until pale and thick, then cool.
Beat the mascarpone into the yolks, whip the cream to soft peaks and fold it in.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in the coffee and line a dish; spread half the cream on top and repeat.
Chill at least 6 hours and dust thickly with cocoa before serving.

recipes.name: Panna Cotta with Raspberry Sauce
recipes.description: Wobbly vanilla cream set with gelatin and topped with a bright raspberry sauce.
instructions: Soak the gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes.
Heat cream, milk, 80 g sugar and vanilla until steaming, remove from heat and dissolve the squeezed gelatin in it.
Pour into 6 glasses or moulds and refrigerate at least 4 hours until set.
Simmer raspberries with the remaining sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes, then press through a sieve and cool.
Unmould or serve in the glasses with the raspberry sauce spooned over.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: Rich vanilla custard with a crackling caramelised sugar crust you tap through with a spoon.
instructions: Heat the cream with vanilla until just steaming.
Whisk egg yolks with 80 g sugar and a pinch of salt, then slowly whisk in the hot cream.
Strain into 6 ramekins set in a deep tray; pour hot water around them halfway up.
Bake at 150 C for 35 to 40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble; chill 4 hours.
Sprinkle each with a thin layer of the remaining sugar and caramelise with a torch or under a very hot grill.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: Airy yet intense dark chocolate mousse made with whipped cream and whisked egg whites.
instructions: Melt the chocolate with the butter over a pan of barely simmering water; cool slightly.
Stir the egg yolks and vanilla into the warm chocolate one at a time.
Whisk the egg whites with salt to soft peaks, add the sugar and whisk until glossy.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold into the chocolate, then fold in the egg whites in two additions.
Spoon into glasses and chill for at least 3 hours.

recipes.name: Baked Vanilla Cheesecake
recipes.description: Creamy New York-style cheesecake on a buttery biscuit base, baked low and slow.
instructions: Crush the biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into a lined 23 cm springform tin; bake 10 minutes at 170 C.
Beat cream cheese with sugar and cornstarch until smooth, then beat in sour cream, vanilla and lemon zest.
Add the eggs one at a time on low speed, mixing just until combined.
Pour over the base and bake at 160 C for 60 to 70 minutes until the edges are set and the centre wobbles slightly.
Turn off the oven, leave the door ajar for 1 hour, then chill overnight before slicing.

recipes.name: No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake
recipes.description: Chilled cream cheese and whipped cream filling on a biscuit base, crowned with fresh strawberries.
instructions: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and press firmly into a lined 23 cm springform tin; chill 20 minutes.
Soak gelatin in cold water, then dissolve it in 3 tablespoons of hot water.
Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar, vanilla and lemon juice until smooth, then whisk in the dissolved gelatin.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold into the cheese mixture; spread over the base.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours, then top with halved strawberries and a drizzle of warmed jam.

recipes.name: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Dense, glossy-topped brownies made with real dark chocolate and toasted walnuts.
instructions: Melt the chocolate and butter together, then cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk eggs with sugar and vanilla for 3 minutes until pale and thick.
Stir in the melted chocolate, then fold in flour, cocoa and salt until just combined; add the walnuts.
Pour into a lined 20 cm square tin and bake at 175 C for 25 to 28 minutes until the top is set but the centre is still soft.
Cool completely in the tin before cutting into squares.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy brown-sugar cookies with crisp edges and pockets of melted chocolate chips.
instructions: Cream the soft butter with brown sugar and white sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix flour, baking soda and salt, stir into the butter mixture, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop heaped tablespoons onto lined trays, spacing well apart, and chill 15 minutes.
Bake at 180 C for 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges; cool on the tray 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
recipes.description: Buttery shortbread base topped with a tangy baked lemon curd and a snowy dusting of sugar.
instructions: Mix flour, 60 g powdered sugar and a pinch of salt, rub in the cold butter and press into a lined 20 cm square tin.
Bake the base at 180 C for 18 minutes until pale golden.
Whisk eggs with sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice and cornstarch until smooth.
Pour the filling over the hot base and bake 20 to 22 minutes more until just set.
Cool completely, chill 2 hours, dust with powdered sugar and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
recipes.description: Soft cinnamon apples under a crunchy oat and brown sugar crumble, perfect with custard or ice cream.
instructions: Peel and chop the apples and toss with sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice in a baking dish.
Rub the cold butter into the flour until it looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in oats, brown sugar and salt.
Scatter the crumble evenly over the apples without pressing down.
Bake at 190 C for 35 to 40 minutes until the top is golden and the fruit bubbles.
Rest 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist, tender loaf made with very ripe bananas, brown sugar and a handful of walnuts.
instructions: Mash the bananas thoroughly with a fork.
Whisk melted butter with brown sugar, eggs and vanilla, then stir in the bananas.
Fold in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt until just combined; add the walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175 C for 55 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin 15 minutes before turning out.

recipes.name: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
recipes.description: Spiced carrot and walnut cake with a thick, tangy cream cheese frosting.
instructions: Whisk eggs with sugar and oil until smooth, then stir in the grated carrots and vanilla.
Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt and fold into the batter with the walnuts.
Divide between two lined 20 cm tins and bake at 175 C for 30 to 35 minutes; cool completely.
Beat cream cheese with soft butter and powdered sugar until smooth and fluffy.
Sandwich the layers with frosting, cover the top and sides and chill 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
recipes.description: Light lemon sponge soaked while warm with a crunchy sugar and lemon juice drizzle.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time with the zest of both lemons.
Fold in flour, baking powder, salt and milk to make a soft batter.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 170 C for 45 to 50 minutes until golden and springy.
Mix the lemon juice with the powdered sugar and pour over the hot cake, pricking the top with a skewer first.
Cool completely in the tin so the drizzle sets into a crust.

recipes.name: Victoria Sponge
recipes.description: Two feather-light vanilla sponges filled with raspberry jam and softly whipped cream.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until very pale and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time with a spoon of flour each, then fold in the remaining flour, baking powder, vanilla and milk.
Divide between two lined 20 cm tins and bake at 180 C for 22 to 25 minutes until golden and springy.
Cool on a rack, then whip the cream with 1 tablespoon powdered sugar.
Spread jam on one sponge, top with cream and the second sponge, and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Pavlova with Berries
recipes.description: Crisp-shelled meringue with a marshmallowy centre, piled with whipped cream and fresh berries.
instructions: Whisk the egg whites with salt to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy.
Fold in cornstarch, vinegar and vanilla.
Spoon onto a lined tray in a 22 cm circle with a slight dip in the middle.
Bake at 120 C for 90 minutes, then turn off the oven and leave the pavlova inside to cool completely.
Whip the cream with powdered sugar, spread over the meringue and top with strawberries, raspberries and blueberries.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cakes
recipes.description: Individual dark chocolate cakes with a molten centre that flows out when cut.
instructions: Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt the chocolate and butter together and cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, sugar and vanilla until pale, then fold in the chocolate, followed by the flour and salt.
Divide between the ramekins and bake at 200 C for 11 to 12 minutes until the edges are set but the centres jiggle.
Rest 1 minute, run a knife around the edge, invert onto plates and serve immediately with ice cream.

recipes.name: Chocolate Layer Cake
recipes.description: Tall, moist cocoa sponge layered with a glossy dark chocolate ganache frosting.
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla and beat until smooth, then stir in the hot coffee; the batter will be thin.
Divide between two lined 20 cm tins and bake at 175 C for 30 to 35 minutes; cool completely.
Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chopped chocolate, rest 2 minutes and stir smooth; chill until spreadable.
Fill and frost the cake with the ganache and let it set 30 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
recipes.description: Warm date sponge drenched in a buttery brown sugar toffee sauce.
instructions: Simmer the chopped dates in the water with baking soda for 3 minutes and set aside.
Cream 80 g butter with 150 g brown sugar, beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour, baking powder and the date mixture.
Pour into a buttered baking dish and bake at 180 C for 30 to 35 minutes until springy.
Melt the remaining butter with the remaining brown sugar and the cream, simmer 3 minutes to a glossy sauce.
Prick the hot pudding, pour over half the sauce and serve with the rest and a scoop of ice cream.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Raisin Bread Pudding
recipes.description: Thrifty baked pudding of custard-soaked bread cubes with raisins and a crisp cinnamon-sugar top.
instructions: Cut the bread into cubes and spread in a buttered baking dish with the raisins.
Whisk eggs with milk, cream, 100 g sugar, vanilla and half the cinnamon.
Pour the custard over the bread, press down gently and soak for 20 minutes.
Dot with butter and sprinkle with the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.
Bake at 175 C for 40 to 45 minutes until puffed and golden; serve warm.

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Tart
recipes.description: Crisp shortcrust shell filled with vanilla pastry cream and topped with glossy fresh fruit.
instructions: Line a 24 cm tart tin with the shortcrust pastry, prick the base, chill 15 minutes and blind bake at 180 C for 25 minutes until golden; cool.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar and cornstarch; heat the milk with vanilla and pour it over, whisking.
Return to the pan and cook, stirring, until thick; beat in the butter, cover and chill.
Spread the cold pastry cream in the tart shell and arrange sliced strawberries, kiwi and blueberries on top.
Warm the jam with a teaspoon of water and brush over the fruit to glaze; chill until serving.

recipes.name: Churros with Chocolate Sauce
recipes.description: Crisp ridged fried dough sticks rolled in cinnamon sugar, served with thick hot chocolate dip.
instructions: Bring water, butter, 1 tablespoon sugar and salt to a boil, add the flour all at once and stir into a smooth ball; cool 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then transfer to a piping bag with a large star nozzle.
Pipe 10 cm lengths into oil heated to 180 C and fry 3 to 4 minutes until golden, turning once.
Drain and roll immediately in the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.
Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chopped chocolate, stir smooth and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Caramel Flan
recipes.description: Silky baked custard that unmoulds under a pool of amber caramel sauce.
instructions: Melt 150 g sugar in a pan over medium heat without stirring until deep amber, then pour into a 20 cm round tin and swirl to coat the base.
Whisk eggs with the remaining sugar, then whisk in milk, condensed milk, vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Strain the custard over the caramel and set the tin in a deep tray of hot water.
Bake at 160 C for 50 to 60 minutes until set with a gentle wobble; cool and chill overnight.
Run a knife around the edge and invert onto a rimmed plate so the caramel flows over.

recipes.name: Baked Apples with Walnuts and Honey
recipes.description: Whole apples stuffed with walnuts, raisins and cinnamon, baked until tender and glazed with honey.
instructions: Core the apples from the top without cutting through the base and set them in a baking dish.
Mix chopped walnuts, raisins, brown sugar, cinnamon and soft butter and pack into the cavities.
Drizzle with honey and pour the water into the dish.
Bake at 180 C for 35 to 40 minutes, basting once, until the apples are soft but hold their shape.
Serve warm with the pan juices and a spoon of yogurt or ice cream.

recipes.name: Red Wine Poached Pears
recipes.description: Whole pears poached in spiced red wine until ruby red, served with the syrupy reduction.
instructions: Peel the pears, leaving the stalks on, and trim the bases so they stand upright.
Bring wine, sugar, orange zest and juice, cinnamon, star anise and cloves to a simmer in a pan that fits the pears snugly.
Add the pears and poach gently for 25 to 30 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender.
Lift out the pears and boil the liquid for 10 minutes until reduced to a syrup.
Serve the pears warm or chilled with the syrup and a spoon of mascarpone.

recipes.name: No-Churn Mango Lime Sorbet
recipes.description: Three-ingredient frozen mango sorbet blended smooth with lime and honey, no ice cream maker needed.
instructions: Peel and dice the mangoes, spread on a tray and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Blend the frozen mango with lime zest, lime juice, honey and a splash of water until completely smooth.
Serve immediately for a soft-serve texture, or freeze 1 hour more for firmer scoops.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves.

recipes.name: No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.description: Creamy vanilla ice cream from whipped cream and condensed milk, frozen without a machine.
instructions: Whip the heavy cream with vanilla and a pinch of salt to firm peaks.
Gently fold in the condensed milk until no streaks remain.
Scrape into a loaf tin, cover with cling film and freeze at least 6 hours.
Soften 5 minutes at room temperature before scooping; serve with chocolate chips or fresh berries.

recipes.name: Date and Oat Energy Balls
recipes.description: No-bake bites of dates, oats, peanut butter and cocoa rolled in coconut, ready in 15 minutes.
instructions: Soak the dates in hot water for 5 minutes if they are dry, then drain.
Blend dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa, honey and a pinch of salt into a sticky paste.
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Roll in desiccated coconut and chill 30 minutes before eating; keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Truffles
recipes.description: Melt-in-the-mouth ganache truffles with a hint of rum, rolled in cocoa or chopped nuts.
instructions: Finely chop the chocolate and place in a bowl.
Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chocolate, wait 2 minutes and stir until smooth; add butter and rum.
Chill the ganache for 2 hours until firm enough to scoop.
Scoop teaspoons and quickly roll into balls with cold hands.
Roll half in cocoa powder and half in finely chopped hazelnuts; keep refrigerated.

recipes.name: Affogato
recipes.description: A scoop of vanilla ice cream drowned in a shot of hot espresso, finished with shaved chocolate.
instructions: Chill 4 small glasses or cups in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Place a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream in each glass.
Brew 4 shots of strong espresso.
Pour the hot coffee over the ice cream at the table and top with grated dark chocolate and a crushed biscuit.

recipes.name: Classic Scones with Jam and Cream
recipes.description: Tall, fluffy buttermilk scones served warm with strawberry jam and thick whipped cream.
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then rub in the cold butter until crumbly.
Stir in the buttermilk with a knife until a shaggy dough forms; do not overwork.
Pat out to 3 cm thick on a floured surface and cut 8 rounds with a 6 cm cutter.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and bake at 220 C for 12 to 14 minutes until risen and golden.
Whip the cream to firm peaks and serve the warm scones split with jam and cream.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls with Cream Cheese Glaze
recipes.description: Soft spiral buns swirled with brown sugar and cinnamon, topped with a tangy cream cheese glaze.
instructions: Warm the milk, dissolve the yeast with a spoon of sugar and leave 10 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, salt, egg, 60 g melted butter and the yeast milk; knead 10 minutes until smooth, then let rise 1 hour.
Roll into a 30 by 40 cm rectangle, spread with 60 g soft butter and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up tightly from the long side, cut into 12 slices and arrange in a buttered dish; rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 180 C for 22 to 25 minutes until golden.
Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar, vanilla and a splash of milk and spread over the warm rolls.

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Domed bakery-style muffins bursting with blueberries and a crunchy sugar top.
instructions: Whisk flour, 180 g sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk eggs, melted butter, yogurt, milk, vanilla and lemon zest.
Fold the wet into the dry until just combined, then gently fold in the blueberries.
Divide between 12 lined muffin cups, sprinkle with the remaining sugar and bake at 200 C for 20 to 22 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes in the tin, then transfer to a rack.

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
recipes.description: Juicy cinnamon peaches baked under a soft, golden biscuit-style topping.
instructions: Slice the peaches and toss with 60 g sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice and cinnamon; spread in a buttered baking dish.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, baking powder and salt, rub in the cold butter, then stir in the milk to a thick batter.
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the peaches, leaving gaps for steam.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 190 C for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, chewy oat cookies spiced with cinnamon and packed with plump raisins.
instructions: Cream the soft butter with brown sugar and white sugar until light.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then fold in the oats and raisins.
Drop heaped tablespoons onto lined trays and flatten slightly.
Bake at 180 C for 11 to 13 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft; cool on the tray.
